summary:
SlotGuard helps local service businesses cut no-show losses by collecting a small refundable deposit at booking time. Owners get a booking link and a simple dashboard; clients see clear cancel rules. This canvas is the first pass: booking, deposits, refunds, and owner visibility. Pricing, payment provider, and deposit rules are still open.
Product intent: Independent salons, clinics, tutors, and studios (1–5 chairs or rooms) lose money on no-shows. SlotGuard sells to the owner: booking link, deposit rules, and a dashboard. Not a full salon OS.

tasks.title: App skeleton
tasks.goal: Create the app skeleton: server, routes, database setup that migrates and seeds demo data on start, and a /api/health route.
acceptance: The app starts with one command.
A first start creates demo data.

tasks.title: Data model
tasks.goal: Create the data model for: SlotGuard store, Client, Owner, Appointment.
acceptance: SlotGuard store: Persists owners, services, slots, appointments, payment references, and an audit of deposit state changes.
Client: Booker. May be a guest (email or phone only) in v1.
Owner: The paying customer. Login and business profile now, payout settings later.
Appointment: Service, time, client, and the deposit state machine.

tasks.title: Notifications
acceptance: Sends booking confirmed, reminder, and cancel outcomes. Email first. SMS is undecided.

tasks.title: Booking engine
acceptance: Creates appointments against availability and prevents double-booking. Concurrency rules are open.

tasks.title: Deposit & refunds
constraints: Deposit rules: Undecided: deposit amount (percent of the service or a fixed amount), cancel cutoff (for example 24 hours), keep 100% or part on a late cancel, and how no-shows are handled.
Payments provider: Undecided: Stripe (cards, payment intents) or another provider. Affects webhooks, refunds, and the docs pack. The demo build uses a mock.
acceptance: Creates the deposit, then handles capture, refund, and forfeit per the deposit rules. The demo build uses a mock provider that always confirms. A real provider needs webhook verification.

tasks.title: Deposit checkout
constraints: Deposit rules: Undecided: deposit amount (percent of the service or a fixed amount), cancel cutoff (for example 24 hours), keep 100% or part on a late cancel, and how no-shows are handled.
acceptance: Collects the deposit and shows success and an appointment summary. In this demo build checkout is a mock: every deposit is confirmed and no money is charged. Failure and retry behavior are not specified.
Is used by Deposit rules (shown in).
Is used by Public booking page (continues).

tasks.title: Public booking page
acceptance: Client picks a service and a time, enters contact details, and sees the deposit amount and cancel policy before paying.

tasks.title: Owner dashboard
constraints: Pricing model: Undecided: flat SaaS per location, a percentage of deposits, or a hybrid. Must be settled with market research before the strategy is locked.
acceptance: Lists today's and upcoming appointments with the deposit status: authorized, captured, refunded, or forfeited.
Is used by Pricing model (shapes plan).

tasks.title: Cancel / reschedule
constraints: Deposit rules: Undecided: deposit amount (percent of the service or a fixed amount), cancel cutoff (for example 24 hours), keep 100% or part on a late cancel, and how no-shows are handled.
acceptance: Client cancels or reschedules. The system applies the refund or keep rules based on the cutoff.
Is used by Deposit rules (applied in).

tasks.title: Services & availability
acceptance: Owner defines services, prices, durations, and open hours. v1 can be minimal.

tasks.title: Integration and smoke test
tasks.goal: Connect the pieces, run the main flow end to end, and make sure the container builds and starts.
acceptance: The main flow works from the first screen to the stored result.
